messages:
alex: FYI opened PR 4078 to add an 'edge-minimal' install profile for sealed/offline sites. Focus: smallest set of external ports + HSM device binding examples. PTAL @priya @michael
priya: Skimmed. Looks good. Can we include a quick fallback for hosts that can't use nftables? A tiny iptables example would help ops teams.
priya: iptables fallback snippet I use: `iptables -A FORWARD -p tcp --dport 443 -j ACCEPT; iptables -A FORWARD -p tcp --dport 22 -j ACCEPT; iptables -A FORWARD -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT; iptables -P FORWARD DROP`
michael: Also we should document the installer flag we added: `--device-bind=/dev/pkcs11:/dev/pkcs11` so customers on sealed hardware can pass device nodes into the installer container. Add a note about container runtimes (podman vs docker) and rootless limitations.
alex: Good call. I'll add example for podman `--device=/dev/eph-pkcs11:/dev/pkcs11` and a systemd unit snippet for binding via BindPaths.
lina: Confirming PKCS11 env var is PKCS11_LIB_PATH for the runtime. I'm adding three vendor examples: SoftHSM2 (`/usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so`), GuardHSM (`/opt/guardhsm/lib/libghsm.so`), and CloudHSM shim (`/usr/local/lib/libcloudhsm.so`). Also added a short note about slot/token labels for SoftHSM (use `softhsm2-util --show-slots`).
infra-qa: Small QA: our linkcheck bot flagged two 404s in the PR: one relative link to `../private/quickstart` and an absolute internal link to `https://internal/docs/private/install` which 404s in prod. Change both to `/docs/private/install/edge-minimal.md` before merging.
priya: Will push a commit to update links and add the iptables fallback + a short troubleshooting step for permission denied on device nodes (udev, chown, and SELinux tips).
docs-bot: Heads up: Please include a changelog header: "Docs: add edge-minimal profile (PR 4078)" and add `ci/docs-smoke-456` to the smoke-tests matrix. Linkcheck will re-run on push.
michael: Another thought: customers using HSM via a network-attached KMS may need the kms-proxy example. Add a minimal proxy config and cert instructions (use a CSR signed by customer CA). Keeps airgapped teams from needing direct device access.
alex: I'll add a short kms-proxy snippet using `redwood-kms-proxy --listen 127.0.0.1:8443 --tls-cert /etc/kms/proxy.crt --tls-key /etc/kms/proxy.key --backend unix:/var/run/pkcs11.sock` and a note: "use socket proxy when hardware can't be passed into container".
lina: Also included a tiny troubleshooting checklist: 1) check `udevadm info /dev/pkcs11` 2) `chmod 660` + add installer user to `hsm` group 3) if SELinux, `chcon -t container_file_t /dev/pkcs11`
infra-qa: Approved for docs smoke once linkfix + changelog + tests added.
alex: Thanks — merging after CI. Tagging this thread closed.
